title: Restoring an older database may reinstate revoked household membership
description: A restored copy may contain a membership row deleted after the copy was made. Authority rotation invalidates old sessions and tokens but retains that restored membership and provider identity link. After a new sign-in, the former member may regain access unless the later revocation is independently reapplied before ingress opens.
claimed_root_cause: The restore authority transition invalidates authentication artifacts but does not reconcile membership removals or role downgrades made after the restored snapshot.

trace.description: Startup opens the restored database under the configured authority fence.
Authentication initialization prepares the installation authority.
Generation change invalidates authentication artifacts but retains restored membership rows.
The authorization query accepts a restored membership for the newly signed-in user.
Map access relies on householdAccess and could permit a formerly revoked member to read household content.

evidence.description: Membership revocation deletes the membership row.
The invalidation list clears sessions and tokens but does not include membership or account.
The runbook requires authorization checks before ingress opens but does not specify reconciliation of post-copy membership changes.

blockers: No dummy-account restore check was run because the required OS sandbox controls were not verified.
The repository does not establish whether operators retain and replay post-copy membership revocations and role downgrades before reopening ingress.

validation_plan.local: In an isolated sandbox using dummy identities, snapshot one household database, revoke one member, restore the snapshot under a new authority generation, sign in again as that dummy member, and observe only whether a household read succeeds.
validation_plan.deployment: Have the installation owner inspect the restore procedure and independent records for a required reconciliation of post-copy membership and role changes before ingress opens.
